intro:
**Short answer: SMEG's best Black Friday deal right now is the ECF02 espresso machine and grinder bundle at £349, and the FAB28 retro fridge is £200 off at £1,199.** The KLF03 kettle and 2-slice toaster are no longer in SMEG's own sale, so wait for another retailer to cut them.

SMEG's Black Friday sale runs from 29 October to 6 December 2026, so there's no rush unless your colour sells out. Prices were re-checked on SMEG's Black Friday page on 22 November 2026. Every card also has a link to compare Amazon's price, as Amazon often matches SMEG on the popular colours.

body:
## SMEG Black Friday 2026: what's on and when

SMEG's own shop launched its **Black Friday Sale 2026** on 29 October. Each offer is tagged as running until **6 December 2026**, a week after [Cyber Monday](/guides/when-is-cyber-monday-2026-uk/). Black Friday itself is on Friday 27 November (see [when is Black Friday 2026](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) for every retailer's dates).

The sale covers kettles, toasters, coffee machines, the 50s Style fridges and some cooking and laundry appliances. Delivery is free on orders from SMEG's site, but it warns of delays at busy times, so order big items early if you need them before Christmas.

Other retailers such as John Lewis, Argos, AO and Amazon usually match SMEG's sale prices on the popular kettles and toasters. The cards above link to SMEG directly, with an Amazon price check on each. If you see the same model and colour cheaper elsewhere, it's worth checking that retailer's returns policy before you buy.

## SMEG prices to aim for

- **KLF03 kettle:** it was £129.95 in SMEG's sale in October (regular £159.95) but isn't discounted on SMEG's site any more. Around £130 is the price to wait for.
- **2-slice toaster (TSF01):** same story, £129.95 in October. Don't pay full price in November.
- **4-slice toaster (2 long slots):** £169.95 from £189.95. Below £170 is fair.
- **Hand blender (HBF00):** £69.95, down from £99.95. A good price.
- **Espresso and frother bundle:** £279.95 against £399.95. A strong deal if you want espresso without spending £500.
- **ECF02 espresso and grinder bundle:** £349. The best value coffee deal in the sale.
- **FAB28 fridge:** £1,199 from. Aim for £1,199 or less.
- **FAB30 fridge freezer:** £1,399. Aim for £1,399 or less.

Treat bundle 'was' prices with care. The ECF02 bundle's £589.85 adds up the full prices of products bought separately, so the true saving depends on whether you'd have bought the grinder anyway.

## Which SMEG appliances are worth it?

You're paying extra for the design. A SMEG kettle boils water no better than a £40 one, so buy it because you love the look and want it on the worktop for years.

**Kettle and toaster:** the KLF03 and TSF01 are the classic pair and come in the widest range of colours, but neither is discounted on SMEG's site right now. Matte and special-edition finishes often cost more than the 'from' price shown, so pick your colour before comparing prices. If you're particular about tea, the variable-temperature KLF04 kettle (from £189.95) lets you set the water temperature.

**Coffee:** for espresso, the ECF02 and grinder bundle at £349 is the best value in the sale, and the frother bundle at £279.95 suits milky drinks. The EGF03, with a built-in grinder, is good but pricey for a manual machine, so compare it with our [coffee machine Black Friday deals](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/) before buying. If you also bake, see our [KitchenAid Black Friday guide](/guides/kitchenaid-black-friday-deals-2026/) for stand mixers.

**Fridges:** the FAB28 has a small icebox only, which suits a second fridge or a household that rarely freezes things. The FAB30 swaps that for a freezer section. Both are 60cm wide. Check your space and door-hinge side (these are right-hand hinge) before you order, because returning a fridge is a hassle.

## When do SMEG prices drop?

SMEG runs sales a few times a year, and Black Friday is usually the biggest. Discounts are typically a fixed amount off (£20 to £30 on toasters, £200 on fridges), rather than the deep cuts you see on own-brand appliances. As the current offers already run into December, prices are unlikely to fall further on 27 November itself, though another retailer could go a little lower on a single colour.

For more, see [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).

## FAQs

### When is the SMEG Black Friday sale 2026?

SMEG's own shop started its Black Friday sale on 29 October 2026. Its offers are labelled as running until 6 December 2026.

### Is a SMEG kettle cheaper on Black Friday?

It was £129.95 in SMEG's sale in October (down from £159.95), but on 22 November SMEG's site no longer listed it as discounted. Around £130 is the price to look for.

### Is the SMEG kettle and toaster set cheaper than buying them separately?

Only slightly. In October the KLF03 and TSF01 were £129.95 each in SMEG's sale (£259.90 together), and the bundle sells for about £255 at several shops.

### Does SMEG offer free delivery?

Yes, SMEG's own website offers free UK delivery, though it says delivery may be slower during the Black Friday rush.

### Is SMEG worth the money?

If you want the 50s look, yes: they're well made and come with a two-year warranty from SMEG. If you only care about performance, cheaper brands do the same job for less.
